data.one_liner: Production-focused Flutter utilities for notifications, storage, connectivity, and media.
data.what_it_does: A comprehensive utility package providing pre-configured services for push and local notifications, secure storage, Hive CE, connectivity checking, validation, and media/file pickers. It bundles common everyday extensions and helpers for production apps.
use_when: You are building a production Flutter app and want a pre-packaged set of utilities for notifications, storage, and common validations.
You need an integrated solution for push/local notifications with deep-link handling and per-category mute preferences.
avoid_when: You only need a single lightweight utility (like url_launcher or crypto) and want to avoid pulling in a large dependency graph.
Your project does not use Flutter 3.47+ or Dart 3.13+.
strengths: Combines many essential production utilities into a single, cohesive package.
Built-in support for per-category notification mute, cold-start taps, and in-app notification overlays.
Type-safe Result and AsyncState types for robust error handling.
weaknesses: Large dependency footprint due to covering multiple domains (storage, media, notifications, location).
Strict minimum requirement of Flutter 3.47 and Dart 3.13.
data.setup_notes: Requires initialisation in main() before runApp and specific platform configurations for Firebase, permissions, and minimum SDK versions (Android minSdk 24, compileSdk 37).
